description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging functionality, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It manages a chain of LogNode objects to facilitate flexible logging, supports different log levels, and provides convenience methods for logging messages and exceptions with various priorities.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class that provides static methods for logging messages at various levels, managing linked LogNode objects, and acting as a drop-in replacement for android.util.Log.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
